About This Auction

Tract 1 of 2 | 130 Acres | Fredonia, Kansas Selling at Auction November 13, 2026 Located just northeast of Fredonia, Kansas, at 12450 Jade Road, this 130 acre property offers an excellent opportunity for ranchers, livestock producers, outdoor enthusiasts, or those looking for a scenic location to build their dream home. Just minutes from downtown Fredonia and approximately one mile from paved road access, this property combines convenient proximity to town with the wide-open spaces of Southeast Kansas. The land features heavy mixed-grass pasture, average perimeter fencing, and a newer pipe corral, making it well-suited for cattle grazing and livestock operations. Rolling terrain leads to an elevated hilltop with beautiful countryside views and potential for a future homesite. Wildlife in the surrounding area adds recreational appeal, while the property's acreage and location provide flexibility for agricultural, recreational, or residential use. Whether you're looking to expand your existing cattle operation, invest in Kansas pastureland, or establish a rural retreat with room to roam, this property deserves your attention. TRACT 2 OF 2 - 146.5 ACRES NEAR FALL RIVER LAKE AUCTION - NOVEMBER 13, 2026 This 146.5 acre Greenwood County farm is Tract 2 of two tracts being offered at auction on November 13, 2026. Located at 828 CC50 Rd, Toronto, Kansas, north of Fall River, KS and just a few short miles from Fall River Lake, this property offers an excellent combination of grazing, agricultural, and recreational potential. The farm consists primarily of mixed-grass pasture with multiple ponds providing water for livestock and wildlife. A newer pipe corral adds functionality for cattle handling and makes this property well suited for continued livestock use. With plenty of open grass and water already in place, this tract offers an opportunity to expand an existing operation or establish a farm of your own. Beyond its agricultural value, the property sits in an area well known for deer, turkey, and other wildlife. Its proximity to Fall River Lake adds even more recreational appeal. Wide-open Kansas views, beautiful sunrises and sunsets, and plenty of room to roam make this a property you'll want to own!
